evals.prompt: Busco marco teorico para mi tesis sobre desercion escolar en secundaria en Latinoamerica, necesito 10 fuentes peer-reviewed con DOI
evals.expected_output: 10+ fuentes verificadas con DOI, autores, abstract y citas, filtradas por tier de calidad, con citas preliminares
expectations: Returns at least 10 sources and each one carries a DOI
Every source includes authors, year, title, venue and abstract
Each source is labeled with a quality tier; non-peer-reviewed and predatory venues are excluded
Preliminary citations are generated from retrieved metadata, not invented

evals.prompt: Find peer-reviewed papers on transformer quantization for edge devices, last 3 years, with citation counts
evals.expected_output: Ranked paper list with DOI, venue tier, abstract, citation count and a state-of-the-art summary
expectations: Restricts results to the last 3 years and keeps only peer-reviewed or arXiv sources
Ranks the papers and reports a citation count for each
Includes a state-of-the-art summary that cites the retrieved papers

evals.prompt: Verifica si estas 3 referencias existen o son alucinadas: autores, año y DOI de cada una
evals.expected_output: Existence verdict per reference with corrected metadata or not-found report
expectations: Checks each reference against a database (DOI/CrossRef) instead of answering from memory
Returns one verdict per reference: verified, corrected metadata, or not found
Never presents an unverified DOI as verified
